decos.signText: n

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335810705004
decos.signText: The stars dissolved into the water, making it glimmer, which made the budding flower smile.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: After seeing what joy sharing the stars brought, the greedy street spirit was greedy no more.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335810705004
decos.signText: The sun was tickled awake by the sparkles in the rain.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: Soon after, the sun came bounding up and asked if the greedy street spirit had seen the stars lately, since they usually tickle the sun awake to start the morning.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: But then the greedy street spirit tripped and knocked over his crate, spilling the stars into the river.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: The next day, the moon asked the greedy street spirit to keep an eye out for the stars, for the moon dearly missed their company at night.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: And felt so light-hearted that he started floating about, so as to never stumble and fall again.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: e

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: Then the greedy street spirit carried his crate of stars away from the empty night sky.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335548143246
decos.signText: The

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: h

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335810705004
decos.signText: And when the clouds cleared, the moon was not lonely anymore.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: EXIT

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335548143246
decos.signText: Greedy

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: When the greedy street spirit was finally alone again, he watched the stars shimmer and shine in his crate.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: The greedy street spirit wanted the stars so much that he started plucking them from the sky.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: That is why, to this day, street spirits float around and share their goods with everyone … for a fair price of course.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: Then the budding flower paid a visit to the greedy street spirit and inquired if he knew where the stars had gone to, for the budding flower missed gazing up at their shimmering brillance.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335548143246
decos.signText: Street Spirit

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: T

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: He wanted to gaze at the stars whenever he wished.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335827234026
decos.signText: E

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: To celebrate his newly acquired shinies, the greedy street spirit decided to party by the riverbed.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: One night, the greedy street spirit looked up at the night sky.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335481122140
decos.signText: So the greedy street spirit started dancing, all the while staring at his stars.

decos.name: groddle_sign_blank_1335548143246
